Webster's Dictionary of Synonyms and Antonyms is a concise guide to the 
understanding and use of synonyms.

text: It is intended for people who wish to appreciate the shades of difference that exist among English words having the same or nearly the same meaning and who wish to be able to choose the precisely suitable word for a particular purpose.
